_comment: korean: Encar's make; names: Encar's Korean model name (chassis code cut off) -> Encar's English one, from lots that carry both. models: English model_en -> reference model and generation where the name does not say it. badges: a model whose badge names another model. A model name without a generation, where Encar labels only the later one ("2세대", "(4S)"), is the first.
